categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in recombinant protein technology and application solutions, focusing on target and factor proteins, recombinant antibodies, enzymes, and reagents. It serves the biopharmaceutical, in vitro diagnostics, life sciences research, RNA vaccine drugs, gene and cell therapy, and synthetic biology sectors. Additionally, it provides CRO services including custom protein and antibody expression, mRNA and RNA-related services, and technical package transfers.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has developed 7 comprehensive technology platforms and 23 core technologies covering molecular biology, cell biology, immunology, enzyme engineering, synthetic biology, and protein engineering. Key platforms include the Legotein® protein engineering platform, protein molecular evolution platform, antibody development platform, computer-aided protein expression design (CAPE) platform, and GMP-grade large-scale production and quality control platforms. Production involves high-density fermentation, stable cell line construction, protein purification, and strict quality control under ISO and GMP standards.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Customers include global biopharmaceutical companies, vaccine developers, in vitro diagnostic manufacturers, and life science research institutions. The company supports clients in RNA vaccine development, antibody drug discovery, cell and gene therapy, molecular and immunodiagnostics, and synthetic biology. It serves nearly 3,000 customers worldwide, including those developing mRNA vaccines, antibody drugs, and diagnostic reagents.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with expanding overseas markets. It has subsidiaries and operations in Shanghai, Suzhou, Shandong, and the United States (New Jersey and California). Overseas sales have shown significant growth, and the company is actively building its international brand and marketing presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates upstream in the biopharmaceutical and life sciences supply chain as a key raw material and technology provider. It supplies recombinant proteins, antibodies, enzymes, and reagents that serve as critical inputs for downstream drug development, diagnostics, and research applications.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening innovation in recombinant protein design and applications, expanding GMP-grade RNA-related products, and advancing synthetic biology platforms. The company emphasizes AI integration, multi-platform synergy, and full-process application solutions to meet evolving customer needs. It focuses on expanding product pipelines in antibody drugs, gene and cell therapy, RNA vaccines, diagnostics, and life sciences research, while strengthening quality systems and global talent acquisition.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of recombinant proteins, antibodies, enzymes, and reagents. Additional income comes from contract research organization (CRO) services, including custom protein expression, process development, and technology package transfers. The company employs direct sales and distributor channels domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic player in recombinant protein raw materials and solutions, holding significant market shares in target proteins, diagnostic antibodies, and mRNA raw material enzymes in China. It competes with international brands like R&D Systems and PeproTech, focusing on innovation, quality, and localized supply chain advantages to drive import substitution and industry leadership.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 127.6 million, a 16.7% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 54.4 million. Despite short-term declines due to macroeconomic and industry factors, the company maintains substantial R&D investment (39.14% of revenue) and is expanding overseas sales. Total assets are about RMB 2.22 billion with a slight decrease from the prior year. The company employs 566 staff, including 129 R&D personnel.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes proprietary core technologies and integrated multi-platform capabilities to deliver high-quality, stable, and innovative recombinant protein products and solutions. Its Legotein® platform enables novel protein design and enhanced functionality. The company offers comprehensive full-process application solutions tailored to diverse downstream needs, supporting clients’ innovation in biopharmaceuticals, diagnostics, and life sciences. It also prioritizes GMP-grade production, stringent quality control, and rapid response to customer demands, facilitating global competitiveness and import substitution.
